missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Экономика' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'растёт'. 'Страны' is the genitive showing whose economy it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Экономику' is the accusative direct object of 'изучают'. 'Мировую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Экономики' takes the genitive after 'от', showing what conditions depend on.
Strategic focus: Dative complement. 'Экономике' is the dative governed by 'помогает', naming what the government supports.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Экономикой' is the instrumental governed by 'занимаются', naming the field of study. 'Давно' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Экономике' is the prepositional form after 'о'. 'Российской' agrees in the feminine prepositional, marking the topic.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Экономики' takes the genitive after 'без'. 'Сильной' agrees in the feminine genitive, framing a condition.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Экономике' takes the dative after 'по', naming the speciality. A common pattern for fields of expertise.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Экономики' is the nominative plural subject of 'отличаются'. 'Стран' is the genitive plural showing which economies are compared.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Экономику' takes the accusative after 'в' in 'верить в', expressing belief. 'Нашу' agrees in the feminine accusative.
